Description: Pie and Pastry Shop with online sales. The building is an established large kitchen space of a catering company. I sublease part of the kitchen and storage space from the catering company that is the lease holder. I use the permitted kitchen that already exists to bake and produce my desserts. It is not open to the public. I am certified through the health department of Berkeley, as is the kitchen I work from. All of my sales are done online through my website and I drop the desserts off to be picked up by the customers at permitted locations in the city, a restaurant and a cafe.
